metadata.description: Commercial Claude skills from the AI Growth Systems Bootcamp: LinkedIn, newsletter, sales calls, prospecting and skill building. Pair them with the GTM Context Kit.

plugins.name: linkedin
plugins.description: Write and review LinkedIn posts, track what works each week, turn calls into posts, and turn a post's commenters into a ranked lead list.

plugins.name: newsletter
plugins.description: Turn your raw notes, links and posts into a newsletter edition with subject lines, in your own voice.

plugins.name: sales-calls
plugins.description: Prepare for sales calls, coach yourself after them, write the follow-up and the proposal, follow up after webinars, and triage inbound interest.

plugins.name: prospecting
plugins.description: Find where your buyers are and who is worth contacting: Reddit communities and threads, ranked lead lists against your ICP, and personas from form or webinar sign-ups.

plugins.name: skill-building
plugins.description: Audit your own Claude skills and upgrade older ones for Claude 5 models.
